description:
Get a session by ID. Returns the session status, verification details, and proof token if verified.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.
name: get_session

channel.description: How the person proves the number: `telegram` or `whatsapp` (the bot reads the number from their account), or `sms` (they text a short code from the number to one of ours).

verification_id.description: The verification record created on completion (once `verified`)
